import openpyxl

out_path = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(out_path)
ws = wb['Sheet2']

# Clear I2:L13 first (remove existing array formulas and set to None)
for row in range(2, 14):
    for col in range(9, 13):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

# Compute values for F2=70
# Engine LS rows (rows 3-6 in source): B=900,1000,1100,1200; C=B*1.65; D=70*9550/C
# Engine HS rows (rows 8-9 in source): B=700,800; C=B*2.04; D=70*9550/C

power = 70

# Row 2: Header for Engine LS group
ws['I2'] = 'Power (kW)'
ws['J2'] = 'Engine LS'
ws['K2'] = 'Power take-off (rpm)'
ws['L2'] = '(Nm)'

# Rows 3-6: Engine LS data
ls_rpm = [900, 1000, 1100, 1200]
for i, rpm in enumerate(ls_rpm):
    row = 3 + i
    c_val = rpm * 1.65
    d_val = power * 9550 / c_val
    ws.cell(row=row, column=9).value = power
    ws.cell(row=row, column=10).value = rpm
    ws.cell(row=row, column=11).value = c_val
